detail.description: Facts about the action. Plain data: show it as text.

orgId.description: The context the actor was in; null = English9x (for the actor kinds OPERATOR and SYSTEM: none)

seq.description: The log's own order: larger = later

refId.description: the version of the strategy lesson or test

authorDisplay.description: the author as the catalog shows them

code.description: exactly 6 characters, capital letters and digits; fixed for the life of the course (on update: omit or repeat)

examCode.description: the exam; fixed for the life of the course (on update: omit or repeat)
the exam; fixed for the life of the test

variant.description: IELTS: AC or GT; an exam with no variants: null

durationSec.description: the time limit of the section, in seconds

blockers.description: a skill with no question: the test cannot be sent for review

warnings.description: count mismatches: they warn, they do not stop a review

courseIds.description: Published English9x courses, at most the plan's maxCourses

priceVnd.description: The agreed price; locked at creation

seats.description: People who can hold a seat at once, 1 to 100000

active.description: Valid right now: new lessons and attempts can be opened

courseCode.description: Null when the course is no longer visible to the caller

source.description: ORDER (a paid plan) or SEAT (an organisation's licence)

saved.description: what is saved for the current section's questions

mediaId.description: or as a recording (Speaking): a file of the exam

samples.description: scored examples: band, exactly one of text and mediaId, commentary

timeZone.description: IANA zone of the browser; the days of the streak are cut in it

file.description: the filled-in .xlsx made from the template

mediaZip.description: optional .zip of the media files the rows name

contextOrgId.description: The organisation the server applied to THIS request (null = personal)

file.description: the file; its type is read from its bytes

payTo.description: The bank account to pay into. Null while no payment account is configured

qrPayload.description: The VietQR text for the QR code. Null while no payment account is configured

qrPngUrl.description: URL of the QR image (PNG, 512 px). Null while no payment account is configured

transferNote.description: Text the payer puts in the bank transfer: E9X, the order code and the course codes (the order code alone when too long)

licenseId.description: The organisation licence this order pays for; null for a plan order

payTo.description: The bank account to pay into; same rule as qrPayload

planId.description: The plan of a personal order; null for the order of an organisation licence

qrPayload.description: The VietQR text; only while the order is PENDING_PAYMENT and an account is configured

qrPngUrl.description: URL of the QR image; same rule as qrPayload

rejectReason.description: Why the order was not confirmed (REJECTED)

transferNote.description: QR: the transfer note the payer puts in the bank transfer

activation.description: QR: an order the organisation's administrator pays by bank transfer; CONTRACT: active at once, paid under a contract

holders.description: Who holds a seat now; filled for the organisation's own reading, empty in the administrators' list

orderCode.description: The order of a QR licence

accountName.description: Name of the account holder, shown to the payer

active.description: On sale; a learner sees only active plans

maxCourses.description: Most courses one order of this plan may select

priceVnd.description: Price in VND, locked onto an order when it is placed

Problem.description: RFC 7807 problem details; errors[] lists invalid fields/rows, empty otherwise

detail.description: Explanation for this occurrence; never contains internals

type.description: URN identifying the problem class, e.g. urn:e9x:problem:validation-failed

field.description: Path of the offending value in the request, e.g. rows[1].sku

row.description: Zero-based index of the offending list element, null when not row-specific

content.description: title (required), instructions, passage, audioMediaId, imageMediaId: what the learner sees

examCode.description: the exam; fixed for the life of the group

questionVersionIds.description: the member question versions, in order; each one a question of this exam that the author can read

solution.description: transcript, notes: the solution side, never shown before submitting

answerKey.description: the solution side: answers, transcript, sample answer; checked against the answer-key schema of the type

content.description: what the learner sees; checked against the content schema of the type

groupId.description: the group the question is written for (optional; fixed when the question is made)

typeCode.description: the question type; fixed for the life of the question

reason.description: Why the payment was not accepted: 1 to 500 characters, shown to the learner

ownVersion.description: the caller wrote or submitted this version: the server refuses their decision

previous.description: the latest earlier published or archived version of the same item, to compare with

version.description: the version under review; absent when the caller may not read it

content.description: the content fields of the version, without identity or bookkeeping

examCode.description: IELTS | TOEIC; required for AUTHOR, REVIEWER, TEACHER, absent for the others

testId.description: the TEST (not a test version) of an override; only with scope TEST

blocks.description: the ordered blocks: heading, paragraph, table, image, audio, video-upload, video-embed, callout, embedded-question, worked-example
